name: cross-game-recoil-control
description: 部署极其简单，高效，多功能的跨平台压枪脚本，可绕过各大主流反作弊系统，适配《三角洲行动》，《CS2》，《PUBG》等一系列游戏。Effortless deployment, efficient, and versatile cross-platform aimbot script that bypasses major mainstream anti-cheat systems, compatible with games such as Delta Force, CS2, PUBG, and more.
